'use strict';
const http = require('node:http');
const { readFile } = require('node:fs/promises');
const EventEmitter = require('events');

const PORT = Number(process.env.PORT) || 3000;
const cache = new Map();

class Bus extends EventEmitter {
  constructor() {
    super();
    this.count = 0;
  }

  publish(topic, payload) {
    this.count++;
    this.emit(topic, { ...payload, at: Date.now() });
  }
}

const bus = new Bus();

async function handler(req, res) {
  const url = new URL(req.url, `http://${req.headers.host}`);
  if (req.method === 'GET' && url.pathname === '/') {
    let body = cache.get('index');
    if (!body) {
      body = await readFile(__dirname + '/index.html', 'utf8');
      cache.set('index', body);
    }
    res.writeHead(200, { 'content-type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' });
    return res.end(body);
  }
  bus.publish('miss', { path: url.pathname });
  res.statusCode = 404;
  res.end(JSON.stringify({ error: 'not found', path: url.pathname }));
}

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  handler(req, res).catch((err) => {
    console.error(err);
    res.statusCode = 500;
    res.end();
  });
});

server.listen(PORT, () => console.log(`listening on :${PORT}`));

process.on('SIGTERM', () => server.close(() => process.exit(0)));

module.exports = { server, bus, handler };
exports.version = '1.0.0';
var self = this, args = arguments, nothing = undefined, nan = NaN, inf = Infinity;
typeof window !== 'undefined' && (window.onload = function () { document.title += ' ✓'; });
